stage: 32-pair independent confirmation. Do not pool pilot data, tune thresholds or extend this confirmation batch. Passing permits separate live-flow/timer integration validation; failure shelves this unchanged candidate.
policy: Keep the completed Standard hero draft and all intended roles as baseline. Consider at most ten pair swaps, each native-eligible in both directions, excluding user-explicit locked heroes. Evaluate baseline and candidates with the same baseline native best draft plan, three existing enemy presets and role-dependent default own items. Require every training case to preserve wins and signed NW, with strictly higher NW in at least one case. Pick one qualified candidate by unchanged wins-then-mean comparator; exact ties use pair enumeration order. Otherwise retain all roles. Then run the unchanged production strategy/item optimizer on selected roles. No recursive swaps, future draft rollouts or changed opening randomness.
optimization: Each selected state uses the actual production optimizer body, frozen time and 100 item candidates. Swapped roles change role defaults and candidate ordering; this is a role-plus-role-dependent-build intervention. Screening has at most 33 extra simulator calls. Exact unchanged role states reuse marked deterministic baseline optimization/evaluation; execution counts exclude reuse.
evaluation: Same seeded held-out enemy strategy/eligible-role/default-order profiles per pair, excluding exact three-preset/default-opponent cases. Fixed hero lineups and factions. Earlier experiments and uploaded match reports excluded as confirmation. Hidden enemy custom items and all role permutations unmodeled.
acceptance: 10000 stratified paired whole-draft bootstrap resamples. Success lower one-sided 95% bound >= -0.005; severe-loss upper <= +0.005 (lose and signed NW < -20000). First-pick/ban diversity unchanged by design; this candidate tests final configuration only. A small pilot cannot certify PvP gains or live timer/control integration.
production: Unchanged v2.7.7 until evidence and integration validation. No scheduler or recurring AI work.
